name: Stacking toolbox
description: A bin and a lid that register on each other with no connector at all: the bin's inset base drops into the module below and lands on a seating ledge inside it, so a stack comes out square with nothing to bolt. Modules of different heights still line up, and the bin's floor takes a drop-in hole grid for pegs and partitions. 300 × 200 mm is the classic euro-container footprint and prints on a small bed.
